# NOV Top Drive Manual

Manufacturer: NOV

Model: TDS-11SA

## 5.1 Hoisting System

The Top Drive System includes the Hoisting Subsystem and the Brake Subsystem.

The Hook Load (HKLD) variable is displayed with engineering unit klbf.

The Load Pin Sensor sends data to the Pressure Transmitter and the HMI.

Refer to Figure 1, Table 1 and Section 5.1 for the TDS tag TD-CTRL-101.

![Figure 1](nov-figure-1.png)

| Variable | Description | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HKLD | Hook Load | klbf |
| SPP | Standpipe Pressure | psi |
